Chapter 6420: Enough

Chapter 6420: Enough

“You can’t beat me.” Goldblade laughed after seeing the aggression and released his imperial aura.

A golden light infused with saber energy surrounded him and prevented his desires from being ignited. A half-step emperor didn’t fear a stately desolate god.

“What are you doing, Brother Goldblade?” A different villain appeared and said: “You’re stopping Brother Nine-cries from enjoying a nice feast?”

He had a large frame and an ethereal face filled with stars. Whenever he opened his mouth, it looked as if he was ready to devour everything nearby. Nothing could satiate his hunger.

“Ravenous Wolf God.” Goldblade shot a sharp energy blade and struck the newcomer’s stomach, causing him to stagger backward.

“Hmph.” Nine-cries directed his rot aura toward Goldblade, also forcing him back several steps.

“I suppose Brother Nine-cries will get to feast on an imperial corpse soon.” Ravenous Wolf God ranked sixth among the nine - a desolate god with twelve sacred fruits.

He loved to devour living beings. The higher the quantity, the better the feast. He had no control over his hunger either.

“Want a bite?” Goldblade assumed a defensive stance with his saber.

He might be weaker than Nine-cries but had no problem dealing with this so-called wolf god.

“Everything is crumbling yet you are fighting among yourselves, idiots.” An ancestral aura interrupted their fight.

Goldblade and Nine-cries were able to remain standing but Gold-sparrow and Ravenous Wolf God nearly dropped to the ground.

“Heavenly Crane Master!” They became startled at the appearance of this heavenly ancestor.

They looked up and saw a radiant island - Immortal-seek Peak. The man trapped there could easily obliterate all of them.

“What you all should do is find a new place.” Heavenly Crane said.

“What new place?” Ghost-sparrow asked.

“It’s right below you, seize what you can.” Heavenly Crane said.

Nine-cries and Ghost-sparrow looked down at Imperial League.

“Hahaha, decent meals, I suppose.” Nine-cries laughed.

“I won’t be holding back.” Ravenous Wolf God declared.

“Boom!” The floor holding the ocean shattered entirely. Peaks and islands began falling with the water.

Members of Imperial League turned pale upon seeing the apocalyptic descend. However, their emperors were prepared with the supreme formation.

“Rumble!” The barriers endured countless barrages from the land masses.

Since they were created by Ocean-gaze Ancestor and the others, they survived the physical impact.

“Imperial League!” A figure appeared above them, attempting to rot the barriers.

“Nine-cries Emperor!” Those below shouted his title.

“I will burn all of your desires today!” Ghost-sparrow unleashed his special inferno against the barrier.

“No, let me eat them, so many delicious meals, this will last me a while!” Ravenous Wolf God shouted and opened his mouth.

However, even Iron-spear Ancestor couldn’t break the barriers, let alone them.

“Imperial League’s emperors, surrender and I will spare you.” Heavenly Crane’s voice came from above.

Everyone saw the floating Immortal-seek Peak and its fiery radiance. The aura of a primal ancestor suffocated and suppressed everyone except for the strongest emperors.

“Enough, Heavenly Crane.” Ocean-gaze refused.

“Fine, have it your way.” Immortal-seek Peak’s light condensed into a single beam, looking like an energy spear from outer space.

“Go!” Ocean-gaze released his primal anima to deal with the incoming attack.
